title: Storm Sorceress
description: A powerful female sorceress with long flowing purple hair floats above a turbulent stormy sea. She holds a glowing spiral staff in one hand while channeling a swirling vortex of magical energy with the other, as wrecked wooden sailing ships are tossed by massive purple waves below.
prompt: A majestic sorceress with long flowing purple hair and golden crown floats dramatically above a violent stormy sea, wearing white and purple robes that billow in the wind. She holds a tall golden staff with a glowing spiral top in one hand while extending her other hand to conjure a swirling blue and white vortex of magical energy. Below her, multiple wooden sailing ships with purple sails are being destroyed by massive crashing purple waves and lightning during a fierce tempest. Dramatic purple storm clouds fill the sky with lightning strikes and swirling vortex patterns, bats flying in the distance, highly detailed fantasy digital painting.
